message.reasoning_content:
Round 3 action. Cash 21.25. Produce gives 2 goods free. Donkey costs 1, gives 1. Bribe gives influence — influence matters for payout bonus (5% of bank) and presidency. Auction is round 4 only.

I'm president, influence tied 1,1,1. Could bribe 10M for 2 influence → likely max influence for extra 5%. Bribe 10M to a rival gives them cash though. Influence bonus: 5% of bank. Bank includes fees. Alternatively produce + donkey: cash 21.25 → donkey gives goods to sell next rounds.

Bribe 10M gets 2 influence (floor(10M/5M)). That secures max influence → extra 5% of bank. Bank size unknown but likely large. But giving rival 10M cash hurts ranking since final rank by cash. Hmm, bribe to whom? Giving to faction 2 (already richest) vs 1. Rival gets 10M.

Expected bank: total sales revenue over game maybe ~100+ alashi; 5% could be ~5-10 alashi. Worth it? Gains me influence tie-break + presidency.

Alternatively donkey twice can't—only one action. Produce: 2 goods, worth ~8-10 alashi at future sales minus declining price ladder. Sold counter 6 already; prices at 5-6 next market. Actually ladder index 6 → price 5.

Produce gives 2 goods × ~5 each ×1.25 credit ≈ 12.5 alashi revenue. That seems better than influence bonus ~5? Influence bonus is 5% of bank. Bank = 5% commission of total payouts... bank likely sizeable: total sales revenue maybe ~200 alashi across players; commission 5% = 10, plus 5% back. So extra 5% ≈ 10 alashi. Close. But bribe cost 10M goes to rival, boosting their rank.

Produce is safe EV. I'll produce.
